Coram : D.Y. CHANDRACHUD*, HEMANT GUPTA
Constitution of India – Arts. 19, 32 – Petitioners produced Bengali film titled Bhobishyoter Bhoot, a social and political satire about ghosts – Second petitioner-Director of the film received letter on 11 Feb. 19, four days prior to its scheduled release on 15 Feb. 19, from of Police (Intelligence), Special Branch to arrange prior screening of the film by 12 Feb. 19, stating that inputs were received “that the contents of the film may hurt public sentiments which may lead to political law and order issues” – Responded by second petitioner
Decision Date : 11-04-2019 | Case No : WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) No. 306/2019 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
